name: Idols
overview: Scripture firmly commands exclusive devotion to the one true God, forbidding the making or worshipping of idols in any form, whether graven images or molten gods, as emphasized in Exodus and Leviticus. These idols, described as crafted from silver and gold by human hands, are powerless and vain objects of heathen worship, incapable of providing true guidance or salvation. The Lord identifies Himself as the sole God worthy of worship, warning His people against turning to idols and setting up images to bow down to, underscoring the importance of undivided loyalty to Him alone.
